headline: Wall Street and Global Stocks Slide as Renewed AI Doubts Spark Tech Selloff
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq tumbled as revived doubts surrounding artificial intelligence spending triggered a broad tech selloff, weighing on equity markets worldwide.
why: Technology equities, particularly those linked to artificial intelligence, have driven broad benchmark gains; shifts in investor sentiment ripple across global equity indexes.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: Doubts regarding the payback and spending pace on AI infrastructure spurred selling across high-multiple tech shares.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Heavily weighted technology stocks dragged down the broader market index.

why_moved: Equities fell sharply after investors pulled back from high-flying AI stocks amid valuation scrutiny, compounded by rising crude oil prices.
